scope: The user authorized MB-01–05 earlier and MB-06–10 in the current batch. MB-11–15 remain proposed and outside this authorization. Actual Dot desktop acceptance remains an explicit MB-08 gate.
estimateBasis: Unmeasured initial engineering person-day ranges for one experienced maintainer, including local checks; excludes external waits and real-host/application availability. Not agent ETA.
preservedGates: Existing roadmap states remain unchanged, including blocked DW-020 and deferred Claude sign-in.
Real Dot/Astra capability, model and effort acceptance is separate from fixture transport tests.
DW-140 cross-application fidelity remains necessary for new export nodes.
No public bind, hidden network request, credential disclosure, publishing or installed-browser modification.
proposedDependencyChanges: Split DW-320 local assets/providers from optional DW-300/DW-310 application bridges.
Bring the minimal internal recipe contract from DW-400 forward; defer community execution and hosting.

effortPolicyCandidate.allowedEfforts: Negotiate with actual host; do not hardcode the API list as a desktop capability.
effortPolicyCandidate.selection: Record requested, reported and confirmed model/effort separately; block if required selection is unsupported.
effortPolicyCandidate.cost: Use dated actual usage/prices where available; otherwise mark cost unknown.

tasks.title: Typed contracts and reproducible build pilot
acceptance: Scoped strict type gate checks schema-aligned declarations and unknown input boundaries.
Emitted runtime, offline CLI, copied plugin bundle and reproducible output pass.
Document developer build cost and preserve current launcher until source-only distribution tradeoffs are resolved.

tasks.title: Semantic action hierarchy and compact controls
acceptance: Actions have consistent labels, icons, color roles, shape and focus states.
Keyboard, hit areas, narrow windows and 200% zoom are checked; color is not the only cue.
Measure task steps and usable canvas area before and after; no invented savings.

tasks.title: Editor appearance and shared accessibility preferences
acceptance: Light, dark and live system editor appearance are separate from deck theme.
One quick reduce-motion control governs CSS, Web Animations, Three.js, replay and scrolling.
Off cancels active animation loops and leaves usable static interaction; preferences stay outside project content.

tasks.title: Separate audience projection and presenter session
acceptance: Audience document and audience exports omit private notes, project payloads and editor credentials.
Separate restricted loopback origin exposes no editor session/project endpoints; read-only capability and bounded origin-checked messages carry the filtered projection.
Real window sharing/extended display, refresh, popup failure, disconnect and close recovery are recorded.

tasks.title: Resizable slide-following teleprompter
acceptance: Current slide automatically selects its script; sidebar resizes/docks and retains text anchor.
English, Chinese and mixed-text pace plus pauses are calibrated separately from motion.duration.
Start, pause, manual scroll, resume and reduced-motion manual paging work; no microphone required.

tasks.title: Storyboard, asset registry and derived scene contracts
acceptance: Brief produces reviewable per-slide intent, evidence and speaker-script proposals.
Assets have local hashes, rights/provenance, dimensions, alt text and fallbacks; binaries are outside project JSON.
Schema and validator evolve together with copy-preserving explicit migration; free-form extensions do not bypass validation.

tasks.title: Semantic templates, constrained SVG and interaction recipes
acceptance: Comparison, process, timeline, metric, image-caption and cover recipes respond to semantic content.
Measured text and shared derived scenes drive every exporter, with editable native output.
Interactions are allowlisted state machines; keyboard/text alternatives and declared static fallbacks exist.

tasks.title: Single Dot capability handshake and scoped execution grants
acceptance: A real authorized host negotiates supported conversation/model/effort/cancel/usage operations.
Selected adopted roadmap hashes, source baselines, AGENTS rules and acceptance commands are pinned per job.
Deck-generation and code-change have separate scopes; revocation and unsupported required-model paths fail explicitly.
remainingAcceptance: Actual Dot desktop capability handshake, model/effort and task acceptance

tasks.title: Durable jobs, checkpoints and honest progress timeline
acceptance: Bounded monotonic events survive reconnect/restart, leases, retry and cancellation without duplicate application.
Validated artifacts and real units drive progress; opaque inference is indeterminate.
ETA uses comparable runs and critical path with ranges/confidence, or states insufficient history; review and blocked states are distinct.

tasks.title: Evaluate Astra effort and version the routing policy
acceptance: Compare medium/high on repeated representative English, Chinese, evidence, visual, interaction and code-change tasks.
Record acceptance quality, first-pass validity, repairs, latency and actual reported usage; mark unavailable cost unknown.
Store date/corpus/host/model/policy evidence; escalation honors the grant ceiling and no best-effort claim is made without results.

tasks.title: Opt-in image generation and local asset reuse
acceptance: Only opted-in tools/providers receive approved data and chargeable requests; credentials stay outside projects/logs.
Relevant assets retain rights/alt text/content hash and are individually replaceable; offline reopen/export succeeds.
Bounded retries, cancellation and provider idempotency/recovery avoid blind duplicated paid work.

tasks.title: Multiple workers and selected conversations
acceptance: Two authorized workers process independent artifacts with scoped chat inputs and no permission inheritance.
One integrator checks revision/input hashes; coding workers use worktrees or isolated copies and stale patches conflict.
Revocation, crashes, lease theft, delayed completion and duplicate events do not cross scopes or duplicate outputs.
remainingAcceptance: Actual two-worker Dot desktop capability/conversation acceptance; current real host evidence is Codex CLI with selected authored snapshots only

tasks.title: General Three.js scene adapter
acceptance: Approved scene recipes load locally only when needed with measured packaging/resource costs.
Context loss, static fallback, keyboard controls and reduced/off policies work.
Export declares static versus native behavior; editable text is not flattened with the 3D asset.

tasks.title: Figma editable importer acceptance
acceptance: Actual Figma importer runs with a real assigned identity.
Native text/shapes/media, fonts, node mapping and component/fixed-layout decisions are inspected.
Record actual environment and screenshots; exported JSON alone is not acceptance.
remainingAcceptance: Actual native Figma development-plugin registration with assigned id, editable media/font/source-map import and visual review

tasks.title: After Effects temporal importer acceptance
acceptance: Actual AE imports native layers with explicit temporal mapping and easing.
Strict parsing, cancel and rollback preserve existing projects.
Render and inspect real early/middle/settled preview frames; keep unsupported behavior explicit.
remainingAcceptance: Actual After Effects execution, cancellation/rollback, fonts, temporal/easing and early/middle/settled preview rendering
